segments.text: Good afternoon. This is Aakashwani and I am Valsa Williams with the midday news.
The headlines
Prime Minister Narendra Modi holds bilateral talks with Swiss President Guy Pakmaler in New Delhi.
Says India and Switzerland will work together to boost trade, investment and develop trusted supply chains for the world.
India and Switzerland link several agreements to promote cooperation in transportation, technologies,
mobility systems and infrastructure.

to negotiating and finalizing trade agreements.
Benjab and Haryana High Court order CBI probe into ED allegations of corruption against
Punjab Chief Minister's office, and IMD forecasts heavy rainfall over Karnataka, Kerala, Mahi,
Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karayikal till tomorrow.
India and Switzerland today inked several agreements in the field of promotion and collaboration
on transportation technologies, mobility systems and infrastructure. A letter of intent
was also signed between the Department of Science and Technology and the Swiss National
International Science Foundation. An implementation arrangement for cooperation in innovation,
technology transfer and entrepreneurship between the Department of Science and Technology and
the Zurich University of Applied Sciences was also signed. These agreements were signed
after bilateral talks between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Swiss President Guy Pachmalin
in New Delhi. In a joint press meet, Prime Minister Modi appreciated the Swiss President's
commitment to India-Switzerland relations, he said India implemented the Historic Trade
and Economic Partnership Agreement with the European Free Trade Association, EFTA, countries
last October. He said the agreement was India's first free trade agreement with the European

The Reserve Bank of India's Monetary Policy Committee began its three-day meeting in Mumbai
today.
The RBI's policy review comes amid renewed tensions in West Asia, elevated crude oil
prices and concerns over food inflation.
The committee will also assess the inflation outlook and prevailing economic conditions
before announcing its decision at the end of the three-day meeting. The last reporate
hike was in February 2023, when the RBI raised the rate by 25 basis points to 6.5%. It subsequently
kept the rate unchanged through 2023-24 before beginning its rate cut cycle in 2025. The
policy reporate currently stands at 5.25%. This is Aakashwani giving you the news.

The Punjab and Haryana High Court has ordered a central Bureau of Investigation probe into
the alleged corruption and cash for transfers case involving the Punjab Chief Minister's
office.
The court has taken the decision following claims by the enforcement directorate regarding
adding a list of corruption and high-profile cash for transfers involving officer on special
duty to the chief minister. Earlier, the enforcement directorate had reportedly sent
three letters to the Punjab Director-General of Police, seeking resignation of a first
information report, but state police took no action.
The Supreme Court today declined to pass an interim order, seeking suspension of chief
election commissioner Ganesh Kumar over allegations of unilateral decision-making in the election
commission during the Special Intensive Division of Electoral Roads, a bench headed by Chief Justice
Surya Khan's issued notices to the centre, the election commission and other respondents.
The court also observed that it cannot pass an exparte order solely on the basis of

Yemen's internationally recognized government has announced the start of military operations
to take back the remaining Houthi-led territories and restore state authority across the country,
President and Presidential Leadership Council Chairman Rashid al-Alami said the government
had moved from a phase of preparation and readiness to the liberation phase after what
he described as the exhaustion of opportunities for de-escalation.
More from our correspondent.
Yemen's internationally recognized government has announced the start of military operations
to retake Houthi health territories and restore state authority across the country.
Resident Rashad al-Alimi announced this saying that the efforts to de-escalate had been exhausted.
On the ground, Yemeni forces reported heavy clashes across several fronts in Taiz.
They claim to have thwarted Houthi infiltration attempts and reported hundreds of Houthi casualties.
The Houthis, however, have rejected some of these claims.
Meanwhile, Saudi Arabia has pledged full operational support to Yemen's armed forces, saying the
campaign will continue until the state authority is restored.
These developments could potentially escalate the Yemen conflict and open a new phase of
fighting.
Manishiva Akashwani, Dubai
The Indimitrological Department, IMD, has forecast heavy rainfall over Karnataka,
Kerala, Mahi, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Kalaikal till tomorrow.
The IMD said that conditions are likely to become favourable for further withdrawal of
southwest monsoon from most parts of Maratwara and Vidarb and some more parts of Maharashtra
and Chattisgarh during the next two to three days.
The weather agency said thunderstorms and lightning conditions will continue over Uttarakhand,
Telangana, Sabhimalayan, West Bengal and Lakshadeep till tomorrow.
Similar weather conditions are also expected over Nagaland, Manipur, Mesuram and Tripura
for the day. Meanwhile, strong surface winds are expected over Andhra Pradesh during the next
two days. Benchmark domestic equity indices were trading around 0.3% up in afternoon session today.
The CENSEX rose 218 points to 72,128, while the NIFTY added 71 points to 22,493,
when reports last came in. In the broader market at the National Stock Exchange, the
small cap-100 index advanced 0.2% a short while ago.
